tourSubtitle: Follow your guide down the street — point your camera up and around.

model.note: This is your real penguin — but it has no rig or animation clips (checked: 0 animations, 0 skins), which is normal for an AI-generated mesh export. The engine detects that automatically and plays a procedural waddle/bob instead of a skeletal clip, so it still moves. `clipNames` is left in place in case you later swap in a rigged version — the engine will pick up real Idle/Walk/Talk clips automatically if they exist, no other change needed. `scale` 0.28 brings its raw ~1.9m height down to about 0.53m. `standOffMeters` is how far ahead of the camera it stands — 2.5m currently. `modelYawOffsetDeg` 180 corrects this specific model's face being authored toward local +Z instead of the standard -Z 'forward' — if you swap in a different model and it faces the wrong way, tweak this (0 or 180 are the two you'll likely need) rather than editing app.js.
